title: Cached derived coefficient functors, adjunction and square
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ and scheme morphisms, cache the existing total left derived inverse image, total right derived direct image, their existing derived adjunction, and the inverse-image square isomorphism obtained by composing through the equal composites. These are the four unchanged definitions previously in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteDiscreteDerivedCoefficientData. The same API provides a partial record of only pullback and square coherence and its concrete finite-discrete abbreviation, without the right-mate field. The coefficient interfaces share one named, proved EssentiallySmall instance for Profinite, with the same essentiallySmallSelf proof as the former anonymous local instances.

proof.text: Use the existing total derived functors and adjunction. Compose the inverse of leftDerivedUpperStarComp, the equality transport of sq.w, and leftDerivedUpperStarComp for the other composite. Use the proved essentiallySmallSelf instance once for all cached coefficient interfaces; this changes no mathematical object. Name the existing pullback-family type and square predicate once as CoefficientPullbackFamily and CoefficientPullbackSquare; reuse these definitionally identical types in the partial record and its consumer records, avoiding repeated kernel expansion of concrete derived categories. B2: retain the exact adjunction and square construction bodies and make these two bodies non-exposed. Prove coefficientDerivedAdjunction_eq by unfolding its wrapper. Prove coefficientAmbientSquare_app using Mathlib NatIso.trans_app twice and the definitional component of symm, keeping concrete morphism projections folded.

proof_origin.note: A4: cache definitionally identical field interfaces; the four derived wrappers and all mathematical equations remain unchanged. B2, 2026-10-17: no mathematical data changes; hide the two large bodies and provide proved adjunction and square component equations. Return repair: delete the duplicate private triple_app helper; use Mathlib NatIso.trans_app directly.

def coefficientAmbientSquare
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) :
    coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ g ⋙
        coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ f' ≅
      coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ f ⋙
        coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ g'
